svg.title: Where Philippine eagles live
svg.desc: A simplified map of the Philippines. Philippine eagles live on only four islands: Mindanao in the south, which is the stronghold and contains Mount Apo, Samar and Leyte in the middle, and the eastern mountains of Luzon in the north. Estimates of how many remain range from about 180 mature birds to more than 700. Five rescued eagles have been released on Leyte, where the species had been lost.

text.font-family: Georgia, serif
-apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Only in the Philippines, and only on four of its islands.
